The financial system wasn’t built for everyone. We’re changing that. Today, we’re thrilled to unveil our bold vision for the future of tokenization—along with a new visual identity to bring that vision to life.

This isn’t just about redefining Ondo; it’s about reimagining a truly open financial system—one that’s fairer, faster, and more accessible for all. Join us as we build the next era of finance together and stay tuned as we reveal major announcements over the next few days leading up to the first-ever Ondo Summit.

Today’s financial markets are an incredible innovation, but they still suffer from high costs, slow settlement, walled gardens, and manual processes. These limitations make it hard to move assets, use them as collateral across platforms, or shop for the best margin terms.

For many globally, the issue is even more severe: they lack access to high-quality assets altogether. Fintech has tried to address some of these issues, but they mostly address the UX layer, whereas the true problem is at the infrastructure. We believe blockchain technology is the solution.

What public blockchains and DeFi fundamentally offer is access: the ability to own, use, and create financial products and services—wherever you are, whenever you want.

🌍 Access to capital wherever you are, enabled by better distributional infrastructure, including digital bearer assets like stablecoins.

🏦 Access to financial products and services previously only available to wealthy or institutional clients, enabled by smart contract-based protocols.

🔑 Access to custody and control of your assets, enabled by the use of private keys.

🛂 The ability to grant or revoke access to your assets for various financial protocols (to lend against, trade, etc.) at whatever level of granularity you wish, through explicit permissioning.

⏰ Access to these things whenever you want—including moving your assets to different protocols at any time—enabled by 24/7/365 operations.

💡Access to the underlying infrastructure, allowing creation of new financial products and services, enabled by the permissionless nature of public chains.

Bringing this kind of access to traditional financial markets represents a substantial advance in the infrastructure that runs financial markets. You might call it a 'foundational upgrade'. We call it Wall Street 2.0.

Wall Street 2.0 represents the next evolution of financial markets, where traditional systems converge with blockchain technology to create a more accessible, efficient, and inclusive ecosystem.

This new paradigm empowers both institutions and individuals to invest in and build financial products with unprecedented speed, transparency, and flexibility—democratizing access to financial opportunities and lowering barriers to entry.

This isn’t just about a more open financial system—it’s also about broader access to goods, services, intelligence, and information. There’s a word for that: the economy. The open economy.

The open economy isn’t just an evolution in how we access capital; it’s a fundamental shift in how individuals and organizations globally engage with the entire spectrum of economic life. That’s why our mission is to accelerate the transition to the open economy by building the platforms, assets, and infrastructure to bring financial markets onchain.

We’ve recently updated our mission to reflect this reality: 

Our mission is to accelerate the transition to the open economy by building the platforms, assets, and infrastructure to bring financial markets onchain.

We’re incredibly excited to be on this journey. With the help of our clients, partners, and investors, we’ve made tremendous strides towards our mission. But we think the best is yet to come. Over the next few days, we’ll be making major announcements as we work to combine the best of TradFi with the best of DeFi to make our financial system fairer, faster, and more accessible to all.

Onward.
